errors.bad_code: paste the code exactly as the sign-in page shows it
errors.code_not_accepted: the CLI did not accept that code; copy the whole code from the sign-in page and paste it again
errors.command_failed: the CLI command ended with code {code}
errors.command_timeout: the CLI command did not finish in time
errors.container: the login container could not be started
errors.login_failed: the CLI did not accept the code; start again
errors.login_timeout: the CLI did not finish signing in in time; start again
errors.no_agent_image: no agent image to run the CLI from: set {env}
errors.no_pending_login: no sign-in is waiting for a code; start again
errors.no_url: the CLI did not print a sign-in link
errors.volume: the personal login volume could not be read or changed
errors.volume_in_use: a run is still using this login; disconnect it when your runs end
errors.volume_taken: a Docker volume named {volume} already exists and is not this install's login; remove it or rename it to connect

log.logout_failed: {engine} logout before removing the login volume
